recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17021 unless FHIR-I separately wants an editorial pass to make the Scope and Usage introduction mirror the formal definition.
issue_request: FHIR-17021 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for STU3 Binary, requesting that the non-definitional wording "A binary resource can contain any content..." be replaced with a definition that Binary represents the data of a single raw artifact as digital content accessible in native format.
initial_application: The issue was applied in git-svn revision 14340, represented by commit 5a98eb6b3cb2717ab0b1a36cafd65a5dc5e2a7a9, which changed source/binary/binary-spreadsheet.xml to the approved definition. The later source refactor now carries that wording in source/binary/structuredefinition-Binary.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists Binary as an active resource, so source/binary/structuredefinition-Binary.xml is in current build scope. source/binary/binary-introduction.xml still has the old content-list sentence as explanatory Scope and Usage prose, but not as the canonical definition and not in contradiction with the StructureDefinition. Bounded community checks found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence; FHIR-I minutes for 2018-07-09 list FHIR-17021 as Persuasive with Modification.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current Binary definition is already correct, and editing the narrative paragraph to duplicate the formal definition would be redundant rather than necessary for the applied issue.
